q: 太晚了，我的小猫已经睡___了。
zh: 太晚了，我的小猫已经睡着了。
py: tài wǎn le wǒ de xiǎo māo yǐ jīng shuì zháo le
en: It’s late, and my kitten is already asleep.
why: 睡着 (zháo) = fell asleep. 睡了 only says went to bed, and 住 / 开 / 掉 are not results of sleeping.

q: 老师说的话我都听___了，不用再解释了。
zh: 老师说的话我都听懂了，不用再解释了。
py: lǎo shī shuō de huà wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le bù yòng zài jiě shì le
en: I understood everything the teacher said, no need to explain again.
why: 听懂 = understood what was said. 听见 and 听到 only mean the sound reached you, which does not fit "no need to explain".

s: 我放耳机在桌子上了。
s_py: wǒ fàng ěr jī zài zhuō zi shàng le
zh: 我把耳机放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ ěr jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I put my earphones on the table.
why: 放在 must be followed straight away by the place, so the earphones have to move in front with 把.

q: 我的小狗已经学___坐下了。
zh: 我的小狗已经学会坐下了。
py: wǒ de xiǎo gǒu yǐ jīng xué huì zuò xià le
en: My puppy has already learned to sit.
why: 学会 = learned how to do it and can now. 学完 would mean it finished a course of study, which is not what teaching a dog to sit means.

src_py: nǐ de ěr jī zhǎo dào le
task: Ask whether it has been found, with 了没有.
zh: 你的耳机找到了没有？
py: nǐ de ěr jī zhǎo dào le méi yǒu
en: Have you found your earphones?
why: The topic stays in front, then 找到, then 了没有. 没有 is the last word.

s: 这本书我看完了，可是没看懂。
s_py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
zh: 这本书我看完了，可是没看懂。
py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
en: I finished this book, but I didn’t understand it.
why: Correct: 看完 and 看懂 are different results of 看, so both can occur in one sentence.

q: 这扇门被风吹___了，小猫跑了出去。
zh: 这扇门被风吹开了，小猫跑了出去。
py: zhè shàn mén bèi fēng chuī kāi le xiǎo māo pǎo le chū qù
en: The door was blown open by the wind, and the kitten ran out.
why: 吹开 = blew it open, which lets the kitten out. 吹走 would mean carried away, which is odd for a door, and 住 / 掉 do not fit.

q: 我想把我拍的小鸟视频发___网上，让更多人看到。
zh: 我想把我拍的小鸟视频发在网上，让更多人看到。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ wǒ pāi de xiǎo niǎo shì pín fā zài wǎng shàng ràng gèng duō rén kàn dào
en: I want to post the bird video I took online so more people can see it.
why: 发在网上 = ended up posted on the web, a place after 在. 给 needs a person, so 发给网上 is wrong.

q: 冰箱里的狗粮吃___了，得去买了。
zh: 冰箱里的狗粮吃完了，得去买了。
py: bīng xiāng lǐ de gǒu liáng chī wán le děi qù mǎi le
en: The dog food in the fridge is all eaten, I have to go and buy some.
why: 吃完 = used up; the follow-up 得去买 confirms nothing is left. 吃好 means had enough to eat, and 会 and 到 do not fit.

zh: 我把手机放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I put my phone on the table.
why: 放在 must be followed straight away by the place, so the phone moves in front with 把. 了 closes the sentence.

task: Ask the same thing with 了没有.
zh: 你听懂了没有？
py: nǐ tīng dǒng le méi yǒu
en: Did you understand?
why: Verb + result + 了 + 没有 at the end. 听懂 stays glued together.

q: 这篇关于猫的英文文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看___。
zh: 这篇关于猫的英文文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看懂。
py: zhè piān guān yú māo de yīng wén wén zhāng tài nán le wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shì méi kàn dǒng
en: This English article about cats is so hard; I read it three times and still didn’t understand it.
why: 没看懂 = still did not understand. After three read-throughs 没看完 makes no sense, and 没看见 / 没看到 are about not seeing something.

q: 对不起，我发___了，这条消息不是给你的。
zh: 对不起，我发错了，这条消息不是给你的。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ fā cuò le zhè tiáo xiāo xī bú shì gěi nǐ de
en: Sorry, I sent it by mistake; this message wasn’t meant for you.
why: 发错 = sent it wrongly. 发对 would say it was sent correctly, the opposite of the apology, and 清楚 / 干净 do not describe sending.

src_py: shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
task: Say who did it: start with 我 and use 把.
zh: 我把书放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I put the book on the table.
why: 放在 must be followed by the place at once, so the book moves in front with 把.

q: 这个旧的聊天软件我很久不用了，昨天把它卸___了。
zh: 这个旧的聊天软件我很久不用了，昨天把它卸掉了。
py: zhè ge jiù de liáo tiān ruǎn jiàn wǒ hěn jiǔ bù yòng le zuó tiān bǎ tā xiè diào le
en: I hadn’t used this old chat app for ages, so I uninstalled it yesterday.
why: 卸掉 = removed for good, the usual result for uninstalling. 卸走 would mean it was carried off, and 着 / 住 do not fit.

q: 小狗把我的拖鞋叼___了，我找了半天才找到。
zh: 小狗把我的拖鞋叼走了，我找了半天才找到。
py: xiǎo gǒu bǎ wǒ de tuō xié diāo zǒu le wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào
en: The puppy carried off my slippers, and it took ages to find them.
why: 叼走 = carried away, which explains the long search. 叼住 would mean it is holding them in its mouth right now, and a search would not be needed.

s: 小猫已经睡觉着了。
s_py: xiǎo māo yǐ jīng shuì jiào zhe le
zh: 小猫已经睡着了。
py: xiǎo māo yǐ jīng shuì zháo le
en: The kitten is already asleep.
why: The result attaches to 睡 and 觉 is dropped: 睡着 (zháo). 睡觉着 does not exist.

zh: 我买到了两张票。
py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng piào
en: I managed to get two tickets.
why: 了 goes straight after the result 买到, or at the end of the sentence. It never sits between 买 and 到.

s: 你下载完这个软件没有了？
s_py: nǐ xià zài wán zhè ge ruǎn jiàn méi yǒu le
zh: 你下载完这个软件了没有？
py: nǐ xià zài wán zhè ge ruǎn jiàn le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished downloading this app?
why: In the 了没有 question 了 follows the result and 没有 closes the sentence; 没有了 is not a question.

zh: 你看懂说明书了吗？
py: nǐ kàn dǒng shuō míng shū le ma
en: Did you understand the instructions?
why: The question is verb + result + object + 了吗. 看懂 stays together and 吗 is last.

q: 这个题我答___了，老师给了我满分。
zh: 这个题我答对了，老师给了我满分。
py: zhè ge tí wǒ dá duì le lǎo shī gěi le wǒ mǎn fēn
en: I got this question right, and the teacher gave me full marks.
why: 答对 = answered correctly. Full marks rules out 答错, and 清楚 / 干净 do not describe an answer being right.

src: 他把手机里的照片都删光了。
src_py: tā bǎ shǒu jī lǐ de zhào piān dōu shān guāng le
task: Turn it into a yes-no question with 吗.
zh: 他把手机里的照片都删光了吗？
py: tā bǎ shǒu jī lǐ de zhào piān dōu shān guāng le ma
en: Did he delete all the photos on his phone?
why: Keep 把 + 删光 + 了 and add 吗. 光 stays glued to 删.

q: 我学了一个星期才学___用这个新软件。
zh: 我学了一个星期才学会用这个新软件。
py: wǒ xué le yí gè xīng qī cái xué huì yòng zhè ge xīn ruǎn jiàn
en: It took me a week to learn how to use this new app.
why: 学会 + verb is "learn to do it". 学完 would say the studying reached its end, but the point is being able to use the app, and 学到 / 学住 do not take 用.

q: 昨天的作业我___做完，所以今天老师批评了我。
zh: 昨天的作业我没做完，所以今天老师批评了我。
py: zuó tiān de zuò yè wǒ méi zuò wán suǒ yǐ jīn tiān lǎo shī pī píng le wǒ
en: I didn’t finish yesterday’s homework, so the teacher criticised me today.
why: Something that did not happen on a past occasion takes 没. 不 or 不会 would be about habit or the future, and 别 is an order.

q: 你可以把这个软件的语言改___中文。
zh: 你可以把这个软件的语言改成中文。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de yǔ yán gǎi chéng zhōng wén
en: You can change this app’s language to Chinese.
why: 改成 + new form: the language becomes Chinese. 改给 or 改在 would need a person or a place after them.

q: 对不起，网络太差，我没听___你说的话，能再说一遍吗？
zh: 对不起，网络太差，我没听清楚你说的话，能再说一遍吗？
py: duì bù qǐ wǎng luò tài chà wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ nǐ shuō de huà néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
en: Sorry, the connection is bad and I didn’t hear what you said clearly; can you say it again?
why: The problem is the poor line, so the sound was not clear: 没听清楚. 没听懂 would blame understanding, not the network.

s: 我没听懂那个视频了。
s_py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng nà ge shì pín le
zh: 我没听懂那个视频。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng nà ge shì pín
en: I didn’t understand that video.
why: 没 already says the result did not come about, so sentence-final 了 cannot be added.

zh: 请把这封邮件翻译成中文。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng yóu jiàn fān yì chéng zhōng wén
en: Please translate this email into Chinese.
why: 翻译成 needs its new form 中文 right behind it, so the email goes in front with 把.

q: 我找___我的耳机了，原来在沙发下面。
zh: 我找到我的耳机了，原来在沙发下面。
py: wǒ zhǎo dào wǒ de ěr jī le yuán lái zài shā fā xià miàn
en: I found my earphones, they were under the sofa.
why: 找到 = the search reached its target, found. 找 alone is only "look for". 懂, 住 and 开 do not describe a search result.

q: 我在公园看___一只很可爱的小鸟。
zh: 我在公园看见一只很可爱的小鸟。
py: wǒ zài gōng yuán kàn jiàn yī zhī hěn kě ài de xiǎo niǎo
en: I saw a very cute little bird in the park.
why: 看见 = the sight registered, i.e. "saw". 看懂 is understood and 看完 is finished watching; neither fits a bird. Bare 看 would only mean looked.

zh: 我洗完澡就去喂鱼。
py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù qù wèi yú
en: I’ll feed the fish as soon as I’ve had my shower.
why: 洗完 is one unit placed before 澡; the object cannot go between 洗 and 完. 就 comes before 去喂鱼.

q: 我在树上看___一只松鼠，可是它一下就跑了。
zh: 我在树上看见一只松鼠，可是它一下就跑了。
py: wǒ zài shù shàng kàn jiàn yī zhī sōng shǔ kě shì tā yī xià jiù pǎo le
en: I saw a squirrel in the tree, but it ran off in a second.
why: 看见 = a glimpse registered. 看懂 and 看完 do not apply to a quick sighting of an animal.

zh: 昨天我没找到小猫。
py: zuó tiān wǒ méi zhǎo dào xiǎo māo
en: I didn’t find the kitten yesterday.
why: 没 sits before the whole verb + result 找到, and 了 is left out. 没 cannot go between 找 and 到.

src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
zh: 我没听懂老师的话。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I didn’t understand the teacher’s words.
why: 没 goes before 听懂 and 了 is dropped. 不听懂 is not a way to report a past failure.

q: 我把照片发___朋友了。
zh: 我把照片发给朋友了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi péng yǒu le
en: I sent the photo to my friend.
why: 给 marks the receiver, so 发给朋友. 在 needs a place, 成 needs a new form, and 发到朋友 is not complete without a place or phone after it.

zh: 他把录好的视频发给朋友了。
py: tā bǎ lù hǎo de shì pín fā gěi péng yǒu le
en: He sent the video he’d recorded to his friend.
why: 发给 is followed at once by the receiver, so the video goes in front with 把 and 了 ends the sentence.

q: 上个星期我一直在找那只流浪猫，可是___找到。
zh: 上个星期我一直在找那只流浪猫，可是没找到。
py: shàng gè xīng qī wǒ yì zhí zài zhǎo nà zhǐ liú làng māo kě shì méi zhǎo dào
en: I kept looking for that stray cat last week, but didn’t find it.
why: The result failed on a past occasion, so 没找到. 不找到 cannot report a past failure.

q: 昨晚外面的狗叫个不停，我很晚才睡___。
zh: 昨晚外面的狗叫个不停，我很晚才睡着。
py: zuó wǎn wài miàn de gǒu jiào gè bù tíng wǒ hěn wǎn cái shuì zháo
en: The dog outside kept barking all night, and I only fell asleep very late.
why: 睡着 (zháo) = actually fell asleep; 很晚才 marks the late moment it happened. 睡了 would only say went to bed.

s: 我写完报告就去喂猫，你等我一下。
s_py: wǒ xiě wán bào gào jiù qù wèi māo nǐ děng wǒ yī xià
zh: 我写完报告就去喂猫，你等我一下。
py: wǒ xiě wán bào gào jiù qù wèi māo nǐ děng wǒ yī xià
en: I’ll feed the cat as soon as I’ve written the report, wait for me a moment.
why: Correct: in "after A, do B" the 完 does not need 了, and the object follows 写完. Leaving 了 out is normal here.

src_py: wǒ xiě duì le nǐ de míng zi
task: Say you wrote it wrong instead.
zh: 我写错了你的名字。
py: wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
en: I wrote your name wrong.
why: Swap the result 对 for 错; 写错 stays together and 了 follows it.

q: 你看清楚那只鸟___吗？
zh: 你看清楚那只鸟了吗？
py: nǐ kàn qīng chǔ nà zhǐ niǎo le ma
en: Did you get a clear look at that bird?
why: The yes-no question is verb + result + 了吗. 没吗 and 不吗 are not combinations, and 过 would ask about experience.

s: 我看了完那个视频。
s_py: wǒ kàn le wán nà ge shì pín
zh: 我看完那个视频了。
py: wǒ kàn wán nà ge shì pín le
en: I’ve finished that video.
why: 了 cannot come between verb and result. 看完 stays together and 了 follows it or ends the sentence.

zh: 我养的小狗已经学会坐下了。
py: wǒ yǎng de xiǎo gǒu yǐ jīng xué huì zuò xià le
en: The dog I keep has already learned to sit.
why: 学会 + skill is the learned-ability result, with 已经 before it and 了 at the end. 了 cannot sit between 学 and 会.

q: 朋友把他养的小猫送___我了，它特别可爱。
zh: 朋友把他养的小猫送给我了，它特别可爱。
py: péng yǒu bǎ tā yǎng de xiǎo māo sòng gěi wǒ le tā tè bié kě ài
en: My friend gave me his kitten, it’s really cute.
why: 送给我 = gave it to me, with the receiver straight after 给. 送走 would mean sent away and cannot be followed by 我了.

s: 老师，我没听见，请再说一遍。
s_py: lǎo shī wǒ méi tīng jiàn qǐng zài shuō yī biàn
zh: 老师，我没听见，请再说一遍。
py: lǎo shī wǒ méi tīng jiàn qǐng zài shuō yī biàn
en: Teacher, I didn’t hear, please say it again.
why: Correct: 没听见 = the sound did not reach me. No 了 is needed after 没.

q: 我把充电器放___书包里了。
zh: 我把充电器放在书包里了。
py: wǒ bǎ chōng diàn qì fàng zài shū bāo lǐ le
en: I put the charger in my bag.
why: 放在 + place = ended up there. 给 needs a person and 成 a new form; neither fits 书包里.

q: 我猜了三次，终于猜___了这只小狗的年龄。
zh: 我猜了三次，终于猜对了这只小狗的年龄。
py: wǒ cāi le sān cì zhōng yú cāi duì le zhè zhǐ xiǎo gǒu de nián líng
en: I guessed three times and finally guessed the puppy’s age right.
why: 终于 signals success after tries, so 猜对 (guessed right). 猜错 is the opposite and 清楚 / 干净 are not results of guessing.

q: 我吃___饭就去遛狗。
zh: 我吃完饭就去遛狗。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù liú gǒu
en: I’ll walk the dog as soon as I’ve finished eating.
why: 吃完饭: the result 完 goes straight after the verb part of 吃饭, before 饭. The other results do not fit eating.

q: 请打___手机上的这个软件，我们一起看看。
zh: 请打开手机上的这个软件，我们一起看看。
py: qǐng dǎ kāi shǒu jī shàng de zhè ge ruǎn jiàn wǒ men yì qǐ kàn kàn
en: Please open this app on your phone and let’s look at it together.
why: 打开 = open something up. 打掉 would mean knock it off or destroy it, and 打住 means stop.

s: 我把照片发给你了，你收到了吗？
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ le nǐ shōu dào le ma
zh: 我把照片发给你了，你收到了吗？
py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi nǐ le nǐ shōu dào le ma
en: I sent you the photo, did you receive it?
why: Correct: 发给你 keeps the receiver straight after 给, and 收到了吗 is the normal result question.

s: 我花了一个晚上才把这个软件学了会。
s_py: wǒ huā le yí gè wǎn shàng cái bǎ zhè ge ruǎn jiàn xué le huì
zh: 我花了一个晚上才把这个软件学会了。
py: wǒ huā le yí gè wǎn shàng cái bǎ zhè ge ruǎn jiàn xué huì le
en: It took me a whole evening to learn to use this app.
why: 了 cannot split 学 and 会; the result 会 follows 学 directly, and 了 comes after it.

src_py: wǒ bǎ jiù yóu jiàn dōu shān diào le
task: Say you have not deleted them yet.
zh: 我还没把旧邮件都删掉。
py: wǒ hái méi bǎ jiù yóu jiàn dōu shān diào
en: I haven’t deleted all the old emails yet.
why: 还没 goes before 把 and the whole verb + result, and 了 is dropped.

q: 请把这首歌的歌词翻译___中文。
zh: 请把这首歌的歌词翻译成中文。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè shǒu gē de gē cí fān yì chéng zhōng wén
en: Please translate the lyrics of this song into Chinese.
why: 翻译成 = turn into another language. 给 would need a person after it and 在 a place, and 中文 is neither.

q: 我的手机电池用___了，现在不能打电话。
zh: 我的手机电池用完了，现在不能打电话。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī diàn chí yòng wán le xiàn zài bù néng dǎ diàn huà
en: My phone battery is used up, so I can’t make calls now.
why: 用完 = used up, nothing left. 好 would mean it is ready or in good condition, which contradicts the battery being dead; 会 only follows learning verbs.

s: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道哪只狗是你的？
s_py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chǔ wǒ zěn me zhī dào nǎ zhǐ gǒu shì nǐ de
zh: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道哪只狗是你的？
py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chǔ wǒ zěn me zhī dào nǎ zhǐ gǒu shì nǐ de
en: If you don’t say it clearly, how would I know which dog is yours?
why: Correct: 不 + verb + result is used in an "if you don’t…" condition, where it is not a past report and 没 would not fit.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le shǒu jī
task: Make 手机 the topic and end with 了.
zh: 手机我找到了。
py: shǒu jī wǒ zhǎo dào le
en: I found my phone.
why: With the object fronted as a topic, 了 closes the sentence, after the result 找到.

q: 昨天晚上网络一直断，所以我___看清楚比赛的结果。
zh: 昨天晚上网络一直断，所以我没看清楚比赛的结果。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǎng luò yì zhí duàn suǒ yǐ wǒ méi kàn qīng chǔ bǐ sài de jié guǒ
en: The connection kept dropping last night, so I never saw the match result clearly.
why: A past occasion where the result did not come about uses 没. 不 would suggest unwillingness or habit, and 别 and 要 do not fit.

s: 他把我的话听成了另一个意思。
s_py: tā bǎ wǒ de huà tīng chéng le lìng yí gè yì si
zh: 他把我的话听成了另一个意思。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de huà tīng chéng le lìng yí gè yì si
en: He took what I said as having a different meaning.
why: Correct: 听成 + new form means heard it as something else, and 了 may follow 成 because the new form comes right after.

s: 对不起，我发了错这条消息。
s_py: duì bù qǐ wǒ fā le cuò zhè tiáo xiāo xī
zh: 对不起，我发错了这条消息。
py: duì bù qǐ wǒ fā cuò le zhè tiáo xiāo xī
en: Sorry, I sent this message by mistake.
why: The result 错 must come straight after the verb and 了 after it: 发错了这条消息. 发了错 splits verb and result.

s: 我看视频完了。
s_py: wǒ kàn shì pín wán le
zh: 我看完视频了。
py: wǒ kàn wán shì pín le
en: I’ve finished the video.
why: The object 视频 cannot split 看 from 完; 看完 is one unit followed by the object.

q: 小猫把盘子里的鱼都吃___完了，一点也没剩。
zh: 小猫把盘子里的鱼都吃完了，一点也没剩。
py: xiǎo māo bǎ pán zi lǐ de yú dōu chī wán le yì diǎn yě méi shèng
en: The cat ate all the fish on its plate, nothing left.
why: The 了 comes after 完, not between 吃 and 完, so the blank stays empty.

q: 你昨天下载的那个软件，你学会用___没有？
zh: 你昨天下载的那个软件，你学会用了没有？
py: nǐ zuó tiān xià zài de nà ge ruǎn jiàn nǐ xué huì yòng le méi yǒu
en: That app you downloaded yesterday, have you learned to use it yet?
why: The question form is 学会用了没有; 昨天 points to a recent completion, which is 了. 过 would ask about past experience.

q: 你把我的手机号码写___了，我打不通。
zh: 你把我的手机号码写错了，我打不通。
py: nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī hào mǎ xiě cuò le wǒ dǎ bù tōng
en: You wrote my phone number wrong, I can’t get through.
why: 写错 = wrote it wrongly, which explains why the call fails. 写对 would be a correct number and contradicts 打不通.

src: 我把这个视频发给了朋友。
src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge shì pín fā gěi le péng yǒu
task: Move 了 to the end of the sentence.
zh: 我把这个视频发给朋友了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge shì pín fā gěi péng yǒu le
en: I sent the video to my friend.
why: 了 can follow 给 or close the sentence. Here it closes the sentence, and the receiver stays right after 发给.

s: 请你翻译这句话成英文。
s_py: qǐng nǐ fān yì zhè jù huà chéng yīng wén
zh: 请你把这句话翻译成英文。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng yīng wén
en: Please translate this sentence into English.
why: 翻译成 needs its new form directly behind it, so the sentence goes in front with 把.

task: Say you’ll go to bed as soon as you’ve eaten.
zh: 我吃完饭就睡觉。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù shuì jiào
en: I’ll go to bed as soon as I’ve eaten.
why: In "after A, do B" the 完 normally carries no 了. 吃完饭 is followed by 就 and the second action.

q: 他的邮件我到现在还___收到。
zh: 他的邮件我到现在还没收到。
py: tā de yóu jiàn wǒ dào xiàn zài hái méi shōu dào
en: I still haven’t received his email.
why: 到现在还 means "up to now, not yet", which takes 没. 不收到 is not used for something that has not happened yet.

q: 等我把这部关于鸟类的纪录片看___，再给你回电话。
zh: 等我把这部关于鸟类的纪录片看完，再给你回电话。
py: děng wǒ bǎ zhè bù guān yú niǎo lèi de jì lù piàn kàn wán zài gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
en: Let me finish watching this documentary about birds, and then I’ll call you back.
why: 看完 = watch to the end. 看懂 would be about understanding it, and 会 is for learned skills. 看着 would be read zhe or zháo and does not fit.

q: 我的手机找到___，你不用帮我找了。
zh: 我的手机找到了，你不用帮我找了。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī zhǎo dào le nǐ bù yòng bāng wǒ zhǎo le
en: I’ve found my phone, you don’t need to help me look.
why: The completed result is marked by 了 after 找到. 过 would mean "ever found", and 着 and 的 do not fit.

q: 我在网上抢了半天，终于抢___了演唱会的票。
zh: 我在网上抢了半天，终于抢到了演唱会的票。
py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng qiǎng le bàn tiān zhōng yú qiǎng dào le yǎn chàng huì de piào
en: After ages of trying online, I finally got a concert ticket.
why: 抢到 = managed to get. 抢完 would mean finished grabbing, and 见 only goes with perceiving verbs like 看 and 听.

q: 你做完作业___没有？
zh: 你做完作业了没有？
py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: In the 了没有 question, 了 follows the result and 没有 closes the sentence. 吗 cannot be combined with 没有.

zh: 我的小狗学会坐下了。
py: wǒ de xiǎo gǒu xué huì zuò xià le
en: My puppy has learned to sit.
why: 学会 + the learned skill, with 了 at the end. 了 does not go between 学 and 会.

task: Say you did not see him.
zh: 我没看见他。
py: wǒ méi kàn jiàn tā
en: I didn’t see him.
why: 没 goes before 看见 and 了 disappears. 没 and 了 cannot appear together.

src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào xiǎo māo le
task: Say you did not find the kitten.
zh: 我没找到小猫。
py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào xiǎo māo
en: I didn’t find the kitten.
why: Negate with 没 before 找到 and drop 了.

q: 他把手机里的照片都打印___了一本相册。
zh: 他把手机里的照片都打印成了一本相册。
py: tā bǎ shǒu jī lǐ de zhào piān dōu dǎ yìn chéng le yī běn xiàng cè
en: He printed all the photos on his phone into an album.
why: 打印成 + new form: the photos turn into an album. 在 would need a place, and 给 would need a person.

s: 我找了半天，没找到那个充电器。
s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān méi zhǎo dào nà ge chōng diàn qì
zh: 我找了半天，没找到那个充电器。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān méi zhǎo dào nà ge chōng diàn qì
en: I looked for ages and didn’t find that charger.
why: Correct: 找了半天 describes the searching, and 没找到 reports that the result never came. 了 does not go on 没找到.

q: 我翻遍了所有的聊天记录，也没有找___那张照片。
zh: 我翻遍了所有的聊天记录，也没有找到那张照片。
py: wǒ fān biàn le suǒ yǒu de liáo tiān jì lù yě méi yǒu zhǎo dào nà zhāng zhào piān
en: I went through all the chat history and still didn’t find that photo.
why: 没找到 = the search never reached its target. 没找完 would mean the searching was unfinished, but 翻遍 says every message was searched.

q: 这个月买宠物用品的钱我都花___了，一分钱也不剩。
zh: 这个月买宠物用品的钱我都花光了，一分钱也不剩。
py: zhè ge yuè mǎi chǒng wù yòng pǐn de qián wǒ dōu huā guāng le yī fēn qián yě bù shèng
en: I’ve spent all my money for pet supplies this month, not a penny left.
why: 花光 = spent until none is left, matching 一分钱也不剩. 花走 / 花开 / 花住 are not words for spending.

q: 我的手机找___到了，原来在床下面。
zh: 我的手机找到了，原来在床下面。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī zhǎo dào le yuán lái zài chuáng xià miàn
en: I found my phone, it was under the bed.
why: 了 never sits between verb and result. It follows the result: 找到了. 找了到了 is wrong.

zh: 我昨天在公园看见一只受伤的小鸟。
py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán kàn jiàn yī zhī shòu shāng de xiǎo niǎo
en: I saw an injured bird in the park yesterday.
why: The time and place come before the verb, and 看见 stays together with the counted object after it. The object cannot split 看 from 见.

s: 昨天的网络课我不听懂。
s_py: zuó tiān de wǎng luò kè wǒ bù tīng dǒng
zh: 昨天的网络课我没听懂。
py: zuó tiān de wǎng luò kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn’t understand yesterday’s online class.
why: A past failure to understand takes 没. 不听懂 is never used for something that happened yesterday.

q: 我的钱包被小偷偷___了。
zh: 我的钱包被小偷偷走了。
py: wǒ de qián bāo bèi xiǎo tōu tōu zǒu le
en: My wallet was stolen by a thief.
why: 偷走 = taken away by the thief. 偷掉 does not exist as a normal word, and 偷住 / 偷着 do not mean stolen.

src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū kàn wán le
zh: 我看完这本书了。
py: wǒ kàn wán zhè běn shū le
en: I’ve finished this book.
why: Without 把, 看完 stays together with the object after it or fronted as a topic. 了 closes the sentence.

q: 你听懂了吗？没有，我___听懂。
zh: 你听懂了吗？没有，我没听懂。
py: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma méi yǒu wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: Did you understand? No, I didn’t.
why: The answer to a result question is 没 + verb + result. 不听懂 is not an answer, and 是 / 不是 do not answer 了吗 questions.

q: 小狗的脚很脏，我给它洗___了。
zh: 小狗的脚很脏，我给它洗干净了。
py: xiǎo gǒu de jiǎo hěn zāng wǒ gěi tā xǐ gān jìng le
en: The puppy’s paws were dirty, so I washed them clean.
why: 洗干净 = washed until clean, the natural result of washing something dirty. 洗清楚 is not said for washing, and 对 / 错 do not fit a cleaning result.

s: 我的耳机找到了，在沙发下面。
s_py: wǒ de ěr jī zhǎo dào le zài shā fā xià miàn
zh: 我的耳机找到了，在沙发下面。
py: wǒ de ěr jī zhǎo dào le zài shā fā xià miàn
en: I found my earphones, they’re under the sofa.
why: Correct: 找到了 puts 了 after the result, with the object fronted as a topic.

zh: 我看见一只小鸟了。
py: wǒ kàn jiàn yī zhī xiǎo niǎo le
en: I saw a little bird.
why: 看见 is glued together and the counted object follows it, with 了 at the end. 看 and 见 cannot be split by the object.

zh: 我还没听清楚他说的话。
py: wǒ hái méi tīng qīng chǔ tā shuō de huà
en: I still haven’t heard what he said clearly.
why: 还没 comes before 听清楚 as a unit, with the object after it or fronted. 了 is not added.

q: 我昨天没找到那只小猫___。
zh: 我昨天没找到那只小猫。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi zhǎo dào nà zhǐ xiǎo māo
en: I didn’t find the kitten yesterday.
why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped. 没找到了 is wrong.

q: 我想把旧手机借___弟弟。
zh: 我想把旧手机借给弟弟。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ jiù shǒu jī jiè gěi dì di
en: I want to lend my old phone to my younger brother.
why: 借给 = lend to someone. 借走 would mean someone took it, and 弟弟 straight after the verb needs 给.

zh: 我把你的名字写错了。
py: wǒ bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě cuò le
en: I wrote your name wrong.
why: 写错 keeps the result straight after the verb. English "wrongly wrote" order does not work in Chinese.

q: 我还没看完这个视频___，你别告诉我结局。
zh: 我还没看完这个视频，你别告诉我结局。
py: wǒ hái méi kàn wán zhè ge shì pín nǐ bié gào sù wǒ jié jú
en: I haven’t finished this video yet, so don’t tell me the ending.
why: 还没 / 没 already negate the result, so 了 must not be added: 没看完这个视频.

s: 这只狗太调皮了，把我的拖鞋叼了走。
s_py: zhè zhǐ gǒu tài tiáo pí le bǎ wǒ de tuō xié diāo le zǒu
zh: 这只狗太调皮了，把我的拖鞋叼走了。
py: zhè zhǐ gǒu tài tiáo pí le bǎ wǒ de tuō xié diāo zǒu le
en: This dog is so naughty, it carried off my slippers.
why: 了 cannot sit between 叼 and 走; 叼走 stays together and 了 follows it.

zh: 他把旧手机里的照片都删掉了。
py: tā bǎ jiù shǒu jī lǐ de zhào piān dōu shān diào le
en: He deleted all the photos on his old phone.
why: 都 comes before the verb 删掉, which stays together, and 了 closes the sentence. The result 掉 cannot be separated from 删.

s: 我睡着了，没听见你的电话。
s_py: wǒ shuì zháo le méi tīng jiàn nǐ de diàn huà
zh: 我睡着了，没听见你的电话。
py: wǒ shuì zháo le méi tīng jiàn nǐ de diàn huà
en: I fell asleep and didn’t hear your call.
why: Correct: 睡着了 (zháo) = fell asleep, and 没听见 reports the sound not reaching me. Neither 睡觉 nor 了 is needed after 没.

src_py: nǐ xiě wán zuò yè le
task: Turn it into a question with 吗.
zh: 你写完作业了吗？
py: nǐ xiě wán zuò yè le ma
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: Keep 写完作业了 and add 吗. 写完 stays together.

q: 这张照片不好看，快把它删___吧。
zh: 这张照片不好看，快把它删掉吧。
py: zhè zhāng zhào piān bù hǎo kàn kuài bǎ tā shān diào ba
en: This photo doesn’t look good, hurry and delete it.
why: 删掉 = get rid of it. 走 means taken away by someone, which is not what deleting does, and 住 / 着 do not fit.

src_py: nǐ bǎ kuài dì ná zǒu le
task: Ask whether it has been done, with 了没有.
zh: 你把快递拿走了没有？
py: nǐ bǎ kuài dì ná zǒu le méi yǒu
en: Did you take the parcel away?
why: Keep 拿走 together, then 了 and 没有 at the end, not 没有了.

zh: 今天的作业我写完了。
py: jīn tiān de zuò yè wǒ xiě wán le
en: I’ve finished today’s homework.
why: Here the object is fronted as a topic, so 写完 stays together and 了 follows it. With the object after, 写完 still stays whole: 写完了今天的作业 or 写完今天的作业了.

q: 请你记___这个新的密码，不要告诉别人。
zh: 请你记住这个新的密码，不要告诉别人。
py: qǐng nǐ jì zhù zhè ge xīn de mì mǎ bú yào gào sù bié rén
en: Please remember this new password and don’t tell anyone.
why: 记住 = fix it in memory. Bare 记 does not say it stuck; 开, 掉 and 走 mean open, removed and taken away, none of which suits a password.
